title: GTA 6 for Xbox: You Can Save $10, Today Only

content:
## Special Savings for Xbox Owners on GTA 6

For Xbox players eagerly anticipating the release of *Grand Theft Auto 6*, a new opportunity to save some money has just emerged. According to a recent report by IGN Games, Xbox owners have a chance to shave $10 off the price of *Grand Theft Auto 6*'s ultimate edition by utilizing a simple workaround.

However, timing is everything for this particular deal. The report explicitly notes that this money-saving method is **only available today**. For fans who have been weighing their options on which edition of Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster to purchase, this unexpected discount provides an immediate incentive to act.

## Understanding the Ultimate Edition Discount

As one of the most anticipated video games in history, *GTA 6* continues to dominate gaming news cycles. The ultimate edition typically targets dedicated fans looking to get the most comprehensive package available, complete with special digital bonuses and extra content. While a $10 price reduction may seem modest in the grand scheme of AAA gaming budgets, any discount on a premier title—especially one tied to a specific workaround—is bound to attract attention from budget-conscious gamers looking to optimize their spending.

While media outlets like IGN have highlighted that the workaround is straightforward, players looking to take advantage of it will need to move quickly before the single-day window slams shut.

## Editor's Take

A ten-dollar discount might not change the game entirely, but every little bit helps when purchasing a major AAA release. If you are an Xbox owner planning to grab the ultimate edition anyway, checking out this workaround today is a no-brainer. Just make sure to act fast before the clock runs out.
